_: Three intakes a year — Spring, Summer, Autumn — and the number of
places open in the one currently taking applications. Every page that
names a date or a seat count reads from here, so the homepage, the
Admissions pillar, the FAQ and both Arabic editions cannot disagree.
WHY THE DATES ARE RULES AND NOT A LIST OF YEARS. Each intake is
stated as a month and a day, and js/intake.js resolves the next
occurrence of each against the reader's own clock. A hard-coded list
of dated intakes is a list that expires — and a countdown that has
expired is worse than no countdown, because it advertises that
nobody is maintaining the page. This one cannot expire: when the
Autumn close passes, the next close is the following Spring.
SEATS. `seats_open` is the number of places in the intake currently
taking applications, and it is a figure like any other — it belongs
to the record and is attested with it in data/standing.json, which
holds the same number. tests/intakes.test.mjs fails the build if the
